thread:
jordan_sales: Heads up - request from Acme Bank (gov/regulated, air-gapped private deploy). They want a one-time onboarding credit to offset our extra on-prem work. Deal: 12mo dedicated commit (~$420k ARR) + managed support. Sales asks $30k credit to cover initial SRE/ops lift. Approvals?

aisha: Need numbers. Is this credit or are we swapping PS fee? Share PS SOW and estimated hours. Also prefer a cap lower than ask.

jordan_sales: PS SOW attached in Deal Desk link. Estimate ~360 hours of field/onprem SRE + audit work (~$45k internal cost). Customer will pay $15k PS; gap = $30k.

carmen_cs: CS notes: will require 2 dedicated oncall rotations for month 1 + extra audit evidence collection. We can cover staffing but need to mark it in support runbook.

amy_revops: RevOps checklist: 1) Confirm SKU for credit posting; 2) One-time onboarding credit ledger entry; 3) Add 90-day churn clawback; 4) GL code mapping.

neha_legal: Legal needs addendum referencing the credit, scope, timeline, and clawback. I can draft a short amendment; need finalized SOW & timeline.

aisha: Finance initial: OK to consider up to $20k one-time credit. Anything above needs CFO sign-off. Conditions: RevOps ledger entry, legal addendum with 90-day clawback, CS signoff on rotations.

jordan_sales: Customer requests kickoff next Tue. Can we get conditional approvals by EOD?

carmen_cs: I can sign off on rotations and timeline. :white_check_mark:

amy_revops: I'll update Deal Desk and prepare ledger entry. Will hold final booking until legal signoff.

neha_legal: Drafting addendum; will aim to circulate in 48 hours. If they need to start sooner we'll use a provisional SOW and mark credit as pending executed addendum.

jordan_sales: OK marking as "conditional approval" for $20k credit. I'll inform the customer and escalate if they insist on $30k.

tom_cfo: @aisha loop me in if they push beyond $20k. We can discuss strategic concession but need A/V from Sales on revenue impact.

ops-bot: NOTE: provisional kickoff scheduled 2026-04-07 pending final paperwork and addendum.
